Actor.description: Who produced the envelope (recorded per journal row).

unit.description: Angle unit of `v`: deg or rad. Required.

AngleUnit.description: Units allowed where the schema expects an angle.

Cat.description: Element category. The wire name (`Cat::key`) is the stable prefix of `cat:id` labels.

oneOf.description: Freeform NURBS surface or shell.
Curtain system of panels and mullions on a freeform surface.
Roof or slab hosted on a freeform surface.
Diagrid, gridshell or cable net on a host surface.
v1 type ref; read as a wall type (the only v1 meaning). New envelopes name the table.
Closed mesh to a parametric solid.
Solid to a plain mesh.
Mesh to the best native element (wall, slab, roof, column, beam).

Curve3.description: A curve given by points (absolute coordinates).

degree.description: Polynomial degree, 1..5 (default 3, lowered when there are too few points).

fit.description: `through`: the curve passes through the points (default); `control`: the points are B-spline control points; `polyline`: straight segments.

Dir3.description: Unitless direction; the executor normalises it.

unit.description: Unit of the value, or null when dimensionless. The key must be present.

FamilyRule.description: Constraint inside a family: planes by name, optional driving parameter.

Field.description: One named field of a `Set` or of a new element's extra rows.

oneOf.description: `twist`: total turn of the profile from start to end; `scale`: profile scale at the path end (1 = none), linear along the path. Both need an open path and a plain profile.

Frame.description: Local frame: profile lies in the x/y plane of the frame, `z` is the extrusion direction.

Group.description: Unit of partial merge: a person may take some groups; `depends_on` names earlier groups.

why.description: Optional rationale for this group; additive, absent on older envelopes.

IfcClass.description: IFC entity of a part: `class` like IfcMember, `predefined` one of its enum values (CHORD).

LatticeHost.description: Host surface of a grid structure (absolute coordinates).

oneOf.description: Spherical cap on a base circle; `oculus` is the radius of the top ring (default a tenth of the radius: a grid cannot meet in the pole).
Circular barrel vault over the level axis `a`-`b` at the springing line.
Saddle over an `lx` x `ly` rectangle, corners at +-`rise`, turned by `angle`.
Flat grid over a `w` x `h` rectangle from `corner`, turned by `angle`.

Dish (paraboloid of revolution) from its `vertex`: rim `radius`, `depth` from the vertex to the rim plane (at most the radius), axis tilted by `tilt` from the vertical toward the plan direction `azimuth`; `hub` is the radius of the inner ring the dish stands on (default a tenth of the radius).

LatticeKind.description: What a grid structure is built as.

oneOf.description: Straight members between ball nodes.
Continuous curved laths clamped at the crossings.
Straight cables between clamps.
The springing ring or line.
Every boundary node.
The four corners of an open grid.

Len.description: A length with its unit, e.g. `{"v": 2100.0, "unit": "mm"}`.

unit.description: Length unit of `v`: m, cm, mm, ft or in. Required.

LenUnit.description: Units allowed where the schema expects a length.

oneOf.description: A bar of a gridshell; only a gridshell (`geometry.gridshell`) holds these, so the model refuses a free one.

Mullion.description: Rectangular mullion section along every panel edge (default 60 x 150 mm).

NewEl.description: New element, one variant per family row of the element contract. `fields` carries the family's remaining rows by name; `Generic` covers families without a typed variant yet.

Op.description: One edit. Wire form is internally tagged: `{"op": "set", ...}`; sub-op families add `"action"`: `{"op": "type", "action": "duplicate", ...}`.

oneOf.description: Geometry ops (section 4, 9). The result keeps its parameters so a later `Set` re-evaluates.

ifc.description: Semantic IFC class of the part; none exports a generic proxy.

name.description: What the part is ("diagonal CHS 508x20"); the solid row's name.

role.description: Component role of the part: a component row of this family is written at `at`.

oneOf.description: Cut a wall or slab by a form (`solids_cut.rs`).
Replace the form parameters of an existing solid or mass.
Change the geometry kind of a mesh or solid; the receipt lists what is lost.
Freeform NURBS surface (a shell when `thickness` is set): roofs, canopies, facades.
Move control point (`i` along u, `j` along v) of a freeform surface to `to`.
Shell thickness of a freeform surface; zero leaves a bare surface.
Trim loops of a freeform surface in normalized surface parameters; none clears them.
New control net of a freeform surface (`count_u` x `count_v` points, degree default 3); the receipt states the largest deviation from the old shape.

Curtain system on a freeform surface: a panel grid with mullions along its edges. `columns` divide along u, `rows` along v (or at absolute heights); `planarize` runs that many rounds of planar-quad optimisation (default none).

flat.description: Largest diagonal gap of a panel still taken as flat (default 1 mm) and as cold-bent (default 20 mm); beyond it a panel is hot-bent.

oneOf.description: Roof or slab on a freeform surface: `layers` stack along the surface normal from the `side` (default normal); `openings` are plan polygons cut through the stack. The element follows later edits of the host.

Diagrid, gridshell or cable net on an analytic host: nodes on a `count_u` x `count_v` lattice of the host, members of the catalogue section `member` (boundary members `edge`, default `member`), ball or clamp nodes of diameter `node` (none sizes them).
One straight structural member from `start` to `end` (absolute coordinates) of the catalogue section `section` ("CHS 88.9x5"): a beam or brace row; `rotation` turns the section about its axis.

Flat plate of `thickness` on the polygon `outline` (absolute coordinates) with `openings` cut through it (see [`plate_kind`]): a horizontal plate is a slab with the openings as holes, an upright rectangular one a wall with a void opening row per opening (its bounding rectangle in the plate). Tilted plates are refused.
Instances move to `replace_with` first; without it, a type in use is refused.

unit.description: Unit of values of this parameter, or null when dimensionless. The key must be present.

oneOf.description: Lands as a draft family; `tests` are the flex-check parameter sets.

unit.description: Length unit of x and y: m, cm, mm, ft or in. Required.
Length unit of x, y and z: m, cm, mm, ft or in. Required.

PanelDiv.description: How a direction of a panel grid is divided.

oneOf.description: `n` panels at equal parameter steps.
`n` panels of equal length along the surface.
Panels of about this length along the surface (count rounded up).
Row lines where the surface crosses these absolute heights, rising (rows only).
`wall:5/axis`, `slab:9/edge:3`, `grid:A`, a drawing polyline.

PatternOut.description: Pattern output: plain copies (default, export-friendly) or one re-evaluating element.

Place.description: A point given by intent; the solver resolves it and the intent is stored.

oneOf.description: Point at parameter `t` (0..1) from `a` to `b`.

Profile.description: Named section shape with parameters (lowered to `gsolid::Section` / `profile.rs`).

oneOf.description: `bulges[i]` belongs to the segment from `pts[i]`; empty means all straight.
A stored profile type.

Ref.description: Reference to something in the model or created earlier in the same envelope.

oneOf.description: Existing row: `wall:55`.
Created by an earlier op of this envelope (its `slot`).
Frozen selection set by name.
By unique name within the category (levels, grids, types, families).
Named face, edge or axis of another ref: `wall:55/face:left`, `slab:9/edge:3`.

RefPlaneDef.description: Reference plane of a family rig, normal to `axis`.

RoleTag.description: A component row written beside a part: it counts as a `name` (blade, gondola), placed at `at`.

ShellKind.description: What a surface shell is in the model.

ShellLayer.description: One layer of a surface shell, listed along the surface normal.

ShellSide.description: Which way the shell grows from the surface (its normal follows u x v).

oneOf.description: Spread `count` copies over `total`.

SurfaceBy.description: How a freeform surface is made.

oneOf.description: Skinned through the section curves in order; `degree` across them (default 3). `params` gives the v parameter of each curve (rising from 0 to 1, one per curve); two lofts that share a column of points and the same `params` meet on one edge. None takes chord-length parameters from the curves.
Straight rulings between two curves.
Profile curve turned about the axis from `axis_a` to `axis_b`.
Control net: `rows[i][j]`, rows along u; all rows the same length. `weights` (same shape, plain numbers > 0) makes it rational.

Network of curves: `u_curves` in order across v, `v_curves` in order across u; every u-curve meets every v-curve. `tolerance` (default 1 mm) bounds both the gaps at the crossings and the deviation of the surface from the curves.
Spherical cap over the circle of plan `radius` around `center` (the rim height), rising `rise` (at most the radius; equal makes a hemisphere). Exact.
Segmental barrel vault along the level line `a` -> `b` (the springing), its arc spanning `span` and rising `rise` (at most half the span). Exact.
Frozen selection set by name.
Filter DSL of `query_elements`, evaluated when the envelope is applied.

UvTrim.description: Trim loops as `[u, v]` pairs of normalized surface parameters (0..1, plain numbers).

outer.description: Kept region; none keeps the whole surface.

unit.description: Length unit of x, y and z: m, cm, mm, ft or in. Required.

Value.description: A parameter value. `unit` must be present on the wire; `null` means dimensionless (text, count, bool, ratio given as a plain number).

unit.description: Unit of `v` (m, mm, ft, m2, m3, deg, kg, kN, kPa, s, pct, ...) or null for a plain number, text or bool. The key must be present.

v.description: The value, expressed in `unit` when a unit is given.

oneOf.description: Mirror about the vertical plane through `a`-`b`.
